description.en: Pagination token for the next page of results

description.zh: 对应新增标签列表，最多包含20个子项
description.en: Tags to filter by. Maximum: 20 items.

descriptions.zh:
请求中至少指定以下任一参数，以确定查询对象。

- ResourceId.N
- Tag.N（Tag.N.Key与Tag.N.Value）

同时指定下列参数时，返回结果中仅包含同时满足这两个条件的资源。
- Tag.N和ResourceId.N
descriptions.en:
Specify at least one of the following parameters to query for resources.

- ResourceId.N

- Tag.N (Tag.N.Key and Tag.N.Value)

If you specify both parameters, the operation returns only resources that match both criteria.

- Tag.N and ResourceId.N

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paistudio list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ResourceGroup --resource-id rgrk6hhjpvio3wvj --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --next-token ad31d453a1f3f23ce0b5e8707e68181f --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun paistudio GET /api/v1/tags --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken ad31d453a1f3f23ce0b5e8707e68181f --ResourceId '["rgrk6hhjpvio3wvj"]' --ResourceType ResourceGroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tag '[{"Value":"TestValue","Key":"TestKey"}]' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
